name: Brawler
description: Frontline bruisers that rely on close-combat pressure, trading blows and forcing direct engagements.

name: Wild
description: Instinct-driven creatures tied to nature and terrain, using regeneration and positional tricks.

name: Tech
description: Engineered or augmented creatures built around precision, efficiency, and combo-heavy play.

name: Mythic
description: Rare, high-impact creatures with unusual abilities that often bend or break normal rules.

name: Evolution Star
description: Represents evolution level; more stars usually mean higher power, tighter synergies, and sharper roles.
